_comment: One per application. Every string here must trace to sources/ or to a fact the candidate confirmed in chat. Never invent. The build refuses to run while any REPLACE or NEED CONFIRMATION text remains.
name: REPLACE - full name, plus post-nominals only if standing rules say so
location: REPLACE - city and region only, or delete this line

links.text: REPLACE - e.g. LinkedIn, or delete the links block

summary: REPLACE. Follow rules/Resume_Rules_Summary.txt. 2-3 sentences. No headcount. No year counts.

competencies.name: REPLACE
competencies.keywords: noun phrase, noun phrase, noun phrase, max 20 words, no verbs

experience.title: REPLACE - exactly as in sources/master_resume.md
experience.description: REPLACE. Max 3 sentences. Situation, mandate, what changed. Never restates the bullets.
bullets: REPLACE. Plain string bullet. Max 2 rendered lines.

bullets.text: REPLACE. A bullet with an inline link:
and the rest of the sentence.

credentialLines: REPLACE - e.g. Certifications: A | B | C   (or delete)
